permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to your own Tailscale-secured bridge (reads/sends iMessages via tetherd over Bluetooth) and, if configured, your chosen speech-to-text provider for voice replies.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Records your voice reply using the phone's microphone, so it can be transcribed and sent as a real iMessage/SMS.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Scans a one-time setup QR code to auto-fill your bridge URL and token, so you don't have to copy/paste them by hand.
